fields.description: Beginner level. The student can understand and use basic everyday expressions and simple phrases.
Elementary level. The student can communicate in simple and routine tasks on familiar topics.
Intermediate level. The student can deal with most situations likely to arise while travelling in a Spanish-speaking country.
Upper Intermediate level. The student can interact with a degree of fluency and spontaneity with native speakers.
Advanced level. The student can express ideas fluently and spontaneously without much obvious searching for expressions.
Proficiency level. The student can understand with ease virtually everything heard or read in Spanish.

fields.title: Private lessons for Adults
fields.description: One to one personalized Spanish lessons for adults tailored to the student's level and learning goals.

fields.title: Private Lessons for Children
fields.description: One to one Spanish lessons specially designed for children with dynamic and engaging activities.

fields.title: DELE Exam Preparation
fields.description: Intensive preparation classes for the official DELE Spanish proficiency certification exam.

fields.biography: She is a Spanish teacher from Bogota, Colombia, with over eight years of experience teaching both children and adults. Throughout her career, she has developed a strong passion for making language learning accessible, engaging, and culturally meaningful. She specializes in creating practical and creative learning materials designed especially for bilingual families, helping parents confidently teach Spanish to their children at home.

Gabriel is a passionate Spanish teacher from Aracataca, Colombia, with over 15 years of experience teaching Spanish literature and language. He specializes in helping students discover the magic of the Spanish language through storytelling and creative expression. His lessons are immersive, imaginative, and deeply rooted in Latin American culture.

Pablo is a dedicated Spanish teacher from Parral, Chile, with expertise in poetry, literature, and language instruction. He brings a lyrical and passionate approach to every lesson, helping students fall in love with the beauty and rhythm of the Spanish language.

Minerva is a highly disciplined and dedicated Spanish teacher from the Scottish Highlands. With decades of teaching experience, she is known for her precision, high standards, and unwavering commitment to her students' success. She specializes in advanced grammar, formal writing, and helping students reach C1 and C2 levels with confidence and elegance.

Rubeus is a warm and enthusiastic Spanish teacher with a big heart and an even bigger passion for language learning. Originally from the West Country of England, he brings energy, humor, and creativity to every lesson. He specializes in conversational Spanish, cultural immersion, and making beginners feel welcome and confident from their very first class.

Severus is a highly skilled and demanding Spanish teacher from Cokeworth, England. With an encyclopedic knowledge of the Spanish language and its literature, he has no patience for laziness or lack of effort. His teaching style is intense and rigorous, but students who commit to his classes consistently achieve outstanding results. He specializes in advanced grammar, literature, and DELE exam preparation.

Edna is an experienced Spanish teacher from Springfield with over 20 years in the classroom. Known for her no-nonsense teaching style and sharp wit, she has a remarkable ability to keep students engaged and motivated. She specializes in grammar, written expression, and exam preparation, and believes that discipline and dedication are the keys to mastering any language.

Professor Super O is a Colombian real hero from Quibdo. His mission is to defend the Spanish language and correct common mistakes. He teaches Spanish with humor, culture, and clear explanations. He helps non-Spanish speakers learn grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation.
His goal is to inspire students to speak Spanish correctly and with confidence.
